sanskrit_verse: पौषमासस्य रोहिण्याम् अष्टकायाम् अथापि वा / जलान्ते छन्दसां कुर्याद् उत्सर्गं विधिवद् बहिः //
transliteration: pauṣamāsasya rohiṇyām aṣṭakāyām athāpi vā / jalānte chandasāṃ kuryād utsargaṃ vidhivad bahiḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: In the month of Pausha, during the asterism of Rohini or the eighth day thereof, or at the conclusion of the rainy season, offerings must be made ritually outside the dwelling according to scriptural ordinance.

IF rainy_season_concludes AND prescribed_conditions_are_met THEN initiate_vidhivat_offering_protocol.
